Repeated hyperparameter and checkpoint selection can overfit validation noise; checkpoints count as additional selection opportunities. [Cawley and Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html) document potentially substantial selection bias. Independent outer evaluation addresses this; [reusable holdouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02629) and [Ladder leaderboards](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v37/blum15.html) control adaptive feedback but require evaluation mechanisms beyond this fixed host protocol. Here, preserve the untouched final test and predeclare trial counts, checkpoint evaluation frequency, stopping rules and selection criteria. These measures limit adaptivity without making validation scores unbiased.

Fixed sampled candidates support paired comparisons, but do not establish full-catalogue ranking quality. [Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/) show that sampled metrics can reverse model rankings, even in expectation. Keep the pinned 99-negative evaluator unchanged and describe results specifically as sampled HR@10. Report category scores alongside their equal-weight macro average. Paired user-level bootstrap intervals, resampling within each category, can describe uncertainty conditional on these candidates; they do not capture training-seed variability or remove selection bias.

A controlled plan inferred from this evidence: compare position-only versus temporal HSTU under identical uniform-negative training, then compare baseline, uniform multi-negative and lexical-negative curricula using one fixed backbone configuration. Preallocate comparable GPU budgets and equal checkpoint-selection opportunities; retain preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, all four datasets and one trained checkpoint per category, without fusion. Record every attempted configuration and compute cost. Treat small validation gains as exploratory, especially when concentrated in one category. Neither promise nor rejection of lexical negatives follows from evaluation methodology alone; require the matched ablation before assigning high potential or abandoning the direction.
